Is the fare the same in both directions?: Yes. Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle, so we keep one route for both directions and passengers can ask either way.
How will passengers look up a fare?: By giving the two stop names, where they are coming from and where they are going.
What should happen if there is no route: Say it was not found. Do not try to join two routes together; only direct routes count.
Can the same route be added twice?: No. If a route between those two stops already exists, in either direction, adding it again must be refused. Change the fare instead.
Can fares have pesewas?: Yes, like 7.50 cedis. A fare must be more than zero.
